title: Detecting a Route Flip Is Easier Than Knowing Whether to Fix It: Causal Route-Mediated Damage in Quantized Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2608.11212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Top-k Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing is discontinuous, so a deployment-motivated numerical disturbance -- simulated 4-bit KV-cache quantization read by a protected BF16 gate -- pushes tokens across decision boundaries and flips which experts fire. This paper proposes no new mitigation; it supplies a causal apparatus, empirical findings, and a detection-limit result. A four-run apparatus prices the route-mediated fraction (RMF) of quantization damage, a token-level attribution decomposes it by mechanism, and pre-registered probes carry the findings across three architectures. On OLMoE-1B-7B at 4-bit KV (pilot), about a third of the damage is routing-mediated: RMF ~ 0.31 (discovery 0.31 [0.20, 0.41]; process-replicated mean 0.313 +/- 0.020; pre-registered re-execution 0.231). translated_title: 检测路由翻转比知道是否修复更容易：量化混合专家中的因果路由介导损伤
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11212v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Top-k混合专家（MoE）路由是不连续的，因此一种部署动机的数值扰动——由受保护的BF16门读取的模拟4位KV缓存量化——将标记推过决策边界并翻转哪些专家被激活。本文未提出新的缓解措施；它提供了因果工具、实证发现和检测极限结果。一个四运行工具评估了量化损伤中路由介导分数（RMF），一种标记级归因按机制分解了它，预注册探针将发现带到三种架构上。在OLMoE-1B-7B上以4位KV（试点）测试，约三分之一的损伤是路由介导的：RMF ~ 0.31（发现0.31 [0.20, 0.41]；过程复制均值0.313 ± 0.020；预注册重新执行0.231）。可部署的路由器余量检测到翻转发生（AUC 0.772），但无法区分有害翻转和有益翻转（处于随机水平）：在测试的局部、推理中...
tldr: 该论文通过因果工具和实证分析，表明在量化混合专家模型中，检测路由翻转是可行的，但判断其是否有害则超出了当前能力。
en_tdlr: This paper shows, through causal tools and empirical analysis, that detecting route flips in quantized mixture-of-experts models is feasible, but determining their harmfulness remains beyond current capability.
